remarks: Nestled on a private one-acre setting in sought-after North Stamford, this four-bedroom raised ranch offers the perfect balance of space, comfort, and privacy just 10 minutes from downtown. Surrounded by mature trees and peaceful surroundings, the home features a versatile layout with three bedrooms upstairs, including a primary suite with ensuite bath, plus a fourth bedroom and additional living space on the lower level. Two fireplaces bring warmth and character throughout, while the screened-in porch is the perfect place to unwind and take in the tranquil setting. Complete with natural gas, a whole-house generator, and a spacious two-car garage, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy North Stamford living with endless potential and timeless charm.
